title: 🔍 Smarter Trade Finder
notes: 🔍 Trade Finder only suggests deals that help BOTH teams. No more pointless pick-for-pick swaps.
🎚️ New filters: choose players or picks on each side, and deal size (1 for 1, 2 for 1, 1 for 2, 2 for 2).
💬 Every idea explains why it helps you and why they'd say yes, plus player headshots.
🎯 FIXED: draft picks for a couple of teams weren't getting their early/mid/late value. Pick values now step smoothly by slot.
